skills.description: Access the Eulogikon corpus of ancient Greek texts — over 1,340 authors and ~4,000 works, Homer through late antiquity, all public domain (CC0 1.0). The downloadable data store is the GitHub repo eulogikon/ancient-greek-texts (PDF, Markdown, plain text). Look up an author or work by canonical identifier, fetch a single work, or plan a bulk crawl. Identifiers are stable: eul_aid for authors (opaque 3-letter code, e.g. 'ffk' = Plato), eul_wid for works (e.g. 'ffk-ag').
skills.name: eulogikon-corpus
